title: Character Selection - Allows you to select a character from a given list and saves the result to a variable.

posts.author: DK
posts.body:
Title:
Character Selection
Version:
1.1.0
Author:
DKPlugins
Description:
Allows you to select a character from a given list and saves the result to a variable.
Features:
Ability to switch the display style of faces or characters.
Full customization of output information.
Ability to customize help text.
Ability to hide the cancel button by requiring a mandatory selection.
Ability to automatically hide the characters that are in your party.
Ability to choose a character from your party.
LITE version restrictions:
One style, no customization.
Compatibility:
RPG Maker MV:
1.5+
RPG Maker MZ:
1.0+
"Help" languages:
English, Russian
Terms of use
You can:
-To use the plugin for your non-commercial projects
-Change code of the plugin
You cannot:
-Delete or change any information about the plugin
-Distribute the plugin and its modifications
Details on obtaining a commercial license on my website
Plugin page:
https://dk-plugins.ru/character-selection/

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
This is a really useful plugin. It lets the player select actors from arrays holding actor ID numbers. You can either give it an array, or use an event to construct an array in-game.
To get the most of it, you want to be able to deal with arrays in Javascript. Here are a couple of links about arrays that that some might find useful:
Really easy-going video tutorial to gently introduce you to arrays of integers in an RPG Maker context:
For those (like myself) who are too old to have been taught JavaScipt at school, here is a general course on JavaScript:
https://www.w3schools.com/js/
With these, and basic eventing knowledge, you should be able to do events that construct arrays containing actor IDs of the whole party, or of sub-sets of the party, or any other selection of actors. If anyone needs help with those, I will help, but not tonight as I have been drinking.
